method: Illustrative designs prompted from verified written product facts. Styling was reframed using only the new project-generated portrait and detail illustration as references.

alt.en: AI illustration of a turquoise glass bead with a pale flower in a silver-tone brooch setting
alt.ja: 白い花模様の青緑のガラス玉を銀色の台に載せたブローチのAIイメージ

images.prompt: Square premium product still-life studio macro photo illustrating a hand-formed turquoise Japanese glass bead brooch with a pale flower inlay set in a low organic polished silver cradle. One complete BROOCH only, slightly oblique from above, form modest and visibly three-dimensional, on light warm-gray textured paper. One teal round or slightly oval bead with a tiny pale petal suggestion INSIDE its surface, silver frame behind and around edge. Use an original demonstrative design, no historic reproduction or exact retail SKU, no copy of real object photographs. Realistic charcoal glass artisan craft feeling and natural soft reflections, whole brooch inside central 62% of the square with airy margins. No detached pins, hardware parts, hands, props, dust flecks, words, brand, logos, symbols or frames.

visualReview.notes: Full glass form and silver setting with clear margins. Flower and setting are illustrative.

alt.en: AI illustration of fine hoops with pointed folded rose-colored petals
alt.ja: 先のとがったくすみピンクの花びらを合わせたフープピアスのAIイメージ

images.prompt: Square premium studio still life of a matching pair of fine warm-metal hoop earrings, each with ONE small antique dusty rose silk flower, folded pointed diamond-like tsumami-zaiku petals. Realistic handmade textile folds and restrained tint, one flower around the same width as each hoop, closed attachment loops. Entirely original illustrative arrangement and petal silhouette, not an exact retail SKU. The pair rests near the center of a clean, pale slightly tinted natural paper stage, separated so the two accessories are individually readable, composition fits in center 65% of frame with broad clear margin on all sides. Soft natural light, editorial macro clarity, simple no extra clasp parts, unrelated items, words, drawings, logos, hands, or border.

visualReview.notes: Both fine hoops are joined to their folded flowers, all visible inside the frame; the clasp details are illustrative.

alt.en: AI illustration of a round silver pendant top with straight and curved lines and no chain
alt.ja: 直線と弧を配した丸い銀のペンダントトップ単体のAIイメージ

images.prompt: Square source image of ONE silver pendant TOP ONLY, single round sterling-silver disc about 21 mm, with a very simple integral small bail at top, NO CHAIN, lying flat on plain softly textured warm stone or paper. The pendant disc has a small original low-relief or engraved abstract composition of intersecting straight lines and a few circular arcs loosely inspired by Japanese chokkomon geometry, clean handwork and polished soft silver. Invent a simple original arrangement, no religious icon, compass rose or exact product design, no replication from a retail listing. Whole medallion with bail clearly visible centered within 60% of frame, soft lateral window light, warm stone quiet texture, powdery still life highlights, no detached parts, stand, extra accessories, hands, stamp, words, dirty marks or frame. Realistic jewelry editorial photography.

visualReview.notes: The silver disc and bail fit within the image with space around the whole piece. No chain or unrelated parts.
